parameters.name: fileId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the recording to download.

schema.description: The unique identifier of the recording to download.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: The category of the file, either channel files or conference recordings.

parameters.name: download
parameters.description: URL behavior, 0 - open(play) for audio/video, others are downloaded; 1 — always download.

id.description: Identity of this emission. Annotations are applied once per id: re-sending one already recorded on the conversation is ignored.

key.description: Identity of the value, when the annotation is one reading of something that changes over the conversation. See AnnotationKey.

AnnotationMetricValue.description:
A named value observed during the conversation, and the reading it replaces — a CSAT score, a
    talk ratio, the outcome of an evaluation. Emitted with an `AnnotationKey`, which is what makes
    the newest reading addressable in `annotationsByKey` while the series stays in `annotations`.

    Runtime services enforce serialized payload size limits.

value.description: The reading, as its producer models it: a score, a label, a number, or an object such as `{"customerRatio": 0.42, "agentRatio": 0.58}`.

previous.description: The reading this one replaces, so a consumer can render the change without loading the history. Absent on the first reading.

label.description: Human-readable name of the value, e.g. 'CSAT' or 'Talk ratio'.

AnnotationResultValue.description: Tool result captured for an annotation. Runtime services enforce serialized payload size limits.

AnnotationSource.description: Producer of an annotation. Generic identifiers allow callers to attach context such as tool id/name, user id/name, etc., without constraining the source type to a fixed shape.

id.description: Stable identifier of the producer (e.g. tool id, user id, copilot session id).

name.description: Human-readable name of the producer (e.g. tool name, user display name).

AnnotationVariablesValue.description: Capability variable values captured for an annotation. Runtime services enforce serialized payload size limits.

propertyNames.description:
Identity of the *value* an annotation carries, as opposed to `Annotation.id`, which identifies
    one emission of it. Two annotations sharing a key are two readings of the same thing — a CSAT
    score that moved, a talk ratio recomputed — so the conversation exposes the newest of them in
    `annotationsByKey` while every reading stays in `annotations`.

    Namespaced by producer to keep keys collision-free across annotation sources, e.g.
    `copilot.csat`, `copilot.talk_ratio`, `copilot.evaluation.objection_handled`. An annotation
    without a key is a one-off record and is not projected.

AnnotationsMap.description:
The newest annotation per `AnnotationKey`: the current value of everything the conversation
    tracks, without reading the history. Keyed annotations only — a one-off annotation appears
    solely in `annotations`.

annotations.description:
Every annotation recorded on the conversation, oldest first — the history of what was observed,
    superseded readings of a keyed value included.

jid.description: A unique identifier to avoid duplicates if user re-connect from different devices.

wordsPerMinute.description: Average words per minute spoken by the participant during the call.

talkRatio.description: Percentage of the call duration during which the participant was speaking.

interruptions.description: List of interruptions where this participant interrupted or was interrupted during the conversation.

talkRatio.description: Percentage of the call duration during which the agent was speaking.

wordsPerMinute.description: Average words per minute spoken by the agent during their speaking time.

interruptions.description: Number of times the agent interrupted another participant during the conversation.

patience.description: Average time in seconds the agent waited after another participant finished speaking before responding.

longestMonologue.description: Duration in seconds of the agent's longest uninterrupted monologue.

longestCustomerStory.description: Duration in seconds of another participant’s longest uninterrupted story or response.

participants.description: Detailed statistics for each participant in the call.

time.description: Time in milliseconds from the start of the call (e.g., flowStartTime) when the interruption occurred.

chunks.description: IDs of the conversation chunks involved in the interruption, including both the interrupting and interrupted speakers.

presignedDownloadUrl.description: The presigned URL for downloading the recording.

version.description: A version of projection that was used to generate the insights.

TranscriptionSentiment.description: Sentiment label for a transcription chunk. Shared between calls and conferences.
